bagPolicy.summary: Bags and purses are not allowed, except clutches up to 4" x 6" x 2" and medical or diaper bags up to 14" x 14" x 6".
allowed: Diaper bags up to 14" x 14" x 6"
Medical bags up to 14" x 14" x 6"
bagPolicy.note: Medical and diaper bags are X-rayed at entry, and bag X-ray is only at Door 5 (main entrance, northeast corner). No bag check is described.

parking.note: Delta Center lists eight nearby lots and the arena door closest to each. Park Place sells game-by-game passes through ParkWhiz. The first 2 hours at City Creek Mall are free. TRAX riders can ride free inside the Free Fare Downtown Zone, and TRAX stops running at 12:00 AM.
parking.summary: Eight nearby lots, each matched to an arena door.
lots: City Creek Mall, 50 East South Temple (Door 5)
Japanese Church of Christ, 268 100 South (Doors 5 and 8)

rideshare.note: For Lyft pickup, go to the southeast corner of the arena on 300 West.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Delta Center varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Sensory Bags can be checked out at Guest Services located on the Main Concourse across from Portal Y/Door 4 free of charge.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is prohibited for Utah Jazz home games. For concerts and other events, the rule varies at management’s discretion.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: All tickets at Delta Center are digital, and paper tickets are not used. Use the Delta Center, Utah Mammoth, or Utah Jazz app to access, transfer, or sell your tickets and for contactless entry.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Door 5, on the northeast corner, is the main entrance and the only door with bag X-ray, so use it if you're bringing an allowed medical or diaper bag. Guest Services is at Door 4/Portal Y on the Main Level.
